# LibreOffice Writer Save Dialog Interface

## System and Application Header

- **Top Bar**
  - Left: "Activities" button
  - Center: "LibreOffice Writer" application title
  - Right: System indicators including date and time ("Oct 23 18:19"), notification bell icon, and system controls (minimize, maximize, close)

## Desktop Environment Sidebar

- **Left Dock (Application Launcher)**
  - Google Chrome icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon (currently active, highlighted)
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - File manager icon
  - Software Center icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Trash icon

## LibreOffice Writer Document Window

- **Document Title Bar**
  - "Untitled 2 - LibreOffice Writer"

- **Menu Bar**
  - File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Table, Form, Tools, Window, Help

- **Toolbar**
  - Contains icons for common functions including:
    - New document
    - Open document
    - Save document
    - Print
    - Cut, copy, paste
    - Find and replace
    - Font formatting
    - Table insertion
    - Special characters
    - List formatting
    - Page layout
    - Drawing tools

- **Document Status Bar (Bottom)**
  - Page indicator: "Page 1 of 1"
  - Word count: "0 words, 0 characters"
  - Page style: "Default Page Style"
  - Language: "English (Hong Kong)"
  - Zoom level: "100%"

## Save Dialog Window

- **Dialog Title Bar**
  - Contains "Cancel" button on the left

- **Navigation and File Path**
  - Current location: "user > Documents"
  - Breadcrumbs: "<" (back), "user", "Documents", ">" (forward)
  - File list area is empty

- **File Name Field**
  - Label: "Name"
  - Input field contains "Untitled 2" with orange border indicating focus

- **Search and New Folder**
  - Search icon (magnifying glass) on the right side of the name field
  - New folder icon (folder with plus sign) on the far right

- **File System Navigation Panel (Left Sidebar)**
  - Home
  - Desktop
  - Documents (selected, highlighted in orange)
  - Downloads
  - Music
  - Pictures
  - Videos
  - Other Locations

- **File List View (Main Area)**
  - Empty, no files displayed
  - Column headers: "Name", "Size", "Type", "Modified" (with dropdown arrow for sorting)

- **Save Options (Bottom Section)**
  - "Encrypt with GPG key" checkbox (unchecked)
  - "Edit filter settings" checkbox (unchecked)
  - "Save with password" checkbox (unchecked)
  - File format dropdown: "Word 2007–365 (.docx)" with dropdown arrow

- **Save Button**
  - Green "Save" button on the top right of the dialog

## Right Sidebar (Document View)

- **Vertical Scrollbar**
  - Located on the far right side of the document area

- **Document Tools Panel (Collapsed)**
  - Contains icons for:
    - Styles (orange icon with "A")
    - Drawing (pencil icon)
    - Text formatting (purple icon)
    - Page layout (blue icon)
    - Document properties (white icon)
    - Character formatting (black icon with "A")

- **Menu Button**
  - Three horizontal lines (hamburger menu) at the top of the right sidebar
